notes.title: Retrospection
notes.content:
Dear Monument Flipper Community! 👋

It’s been a while since the release of the early access of our game. Today, with each step taking us closer and closer to the end of the Early Access phase and release of the full version 🗼 we’d like to take a small break from all the fixes, putting finishing touches and all the work we’re tirelessly doing every single day to assure the full version will be a satisfying experience to all of you. 🔨 

Today, we’d like to take a quick look at what we have achieved throughout Early Access thus far. We wonder how many of you were with us from the very beginning of EA and who followed our steps even longer. Let us know in the comments! 🙂 

Three new maps 
 
The Great Wall of China, a truly monumental structure which dates back to a few centuries bc. A real challenge for those of you who don’t feel overwhelmed by the sheer size of this construction. 🧱

[Luxor Temple], located under the scorching heat of the desert, this magnificent temple stands proudly, keeping the ancient secrets. A location not meant for people of weak nerves, wary of curses and mummies. ☠️

Machu Picchu, the most famous Inca city located over 2000m above sea level ⛰️, is also the best preserved one. Shrouded in mystery of the sudden disappearance of its inhabitants is a place full of valuable artifacts and knowledge about the Inca traditions.

Trophy room 

A new room inside your office. A testament to your effort and achievements. 💪 Place where you can arrange and display all the gifts you’ve received throughout your journey on various occasions. Will you be able to fill in all the shelves? 

New mechanics and fixes 

A tool deterioration mechanism for those of you who look for a more realistic experience and many fixes based on the feedback we’ve received from you. We’re really, really grateful for all the time spent together with you, every single discussion, opinion and tip. We’ve read them all and always appreciated and will appreciate your part in creating this game. 👏

Unfortunately that’s it for today but before we go we’d like to show you a short video and take you on a quick visual journey through the mentioned locations! 🗺️

[previewyoutube=8GZtfoshMxw;full][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png 

See you soon,
Monuments Filpper Team

The break from all this traveling around the world is a great time to tidy up. 🧹 Before the journey to Machu Picchu we’ve decided to refresh and improve the UI. Alice herself- your favorite virtual guide was changed into a more cyber version. Let’s take a look, shall we?

notes.title: Durability
notes.content:
Hello Flippers! 👋

We are happy to see you again in another Early Access devlog. 🙂 This one will be slightly similar to the previous one. Last time, we asked you to come home, take some rest and work on your trophy room. 📝 This time, we’d like you to take a look at your tools… Can’t you see? Those faithful, good old tools that had your back on every single flip thus far… they’re almost completely broken. ⚒️ 

That’s unfortunate but inevitable with the extensive use throughout all the projects. That brings us to the core of changes this devlog introduces to the game- the tools you use will break. 💥 It may not sound like a lot but with the sheer amount of work awaiting you… You’ll have to adjust your budget and take it into consideration. 

Each usage of a tool will drop its durability by one. When its durability drops below a certain level, its icon in the wheel will become yellow, broken tools becoming red. 🚦 Those changes will also make difference in the actual use. As their durability deteriorates, they’ll become less precise and progressively slower in use. Those durability markers will also appear on the objects. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/7da3d93d2ddab5a175c3e051d653d88df02bd5c5.jpg
By the way, we’ve discovered a sculpture dated 1400 years B.C. A young boy holding what resembles a pad in his hands who turned into stone delighted with his gameplay! 🎮 We wonder what title did he play…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/22c18e08b4827b3ed97dc82543084346024edfa7.jpg
Our office immediately picked up on this theory and started betting which game it was. 🤔 Could it be Monument Flipper: Stone Age? 

PS: our friends found something else beside the sculpture and they’re lucky it’s their last day there because what they found made their heart skip a beat. Luckily it was daytime… ⚰️ otherwise those mummies could’ve come to life! 😱

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/da9e7f22287c374a3fd0672ac956fea67af8d86c.jpg
We can’t wait to hear your feedback about the changes we’ve presented today. Hopefully they’ll make the economical aspect matter more in the future but we’d love to know your opinions! 💬 Meet us on discord and share them with us, we await all of you there! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

See you soon,
Monuments Flipper Team

notes.title: Machu Picchu
notes.content:
Flippers, welcome to Peru! 👋

We are grateful that you accepted our invitation and flew ✈️ here so quickly. 

Currently, we're about 2400 m above sea level. The place you’re standing is the very place where in 1911 Hiram Bingham spotted an entire Incan city not plundered by the conquistadors. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/98f38a9639ab9c669c57a5741e4051d7c55a2a06.jpg
That’s right- the task you’re going to face this time is the renovation of Machu Picchu! 🤩 In English called Old Mountain. 🤔

Before you begin your work, let us quickly give you some information about the place!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/89464ac4a9d0df4a58a437e365766678b1525bac.jpg
Building anything in such a taxing environment is not an easy task. Therefore, the creation of Machu Picchu took 10 long years (1450-1460). 

What’s unique about this city is the fact it was inhabited for only 80 years and after that time, all the citizens left. The reason for that remains a mystery to this day. Some people say it was aliens who captured them all. 👽 After all, the way it was built looks like a perfect landing spot for UFO. 🛸

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/ec02b694ce49c4354979dc0227d05e72b04db0ce.jpg
Unfortunately, so far we haven’t found any signs of their visits in this place. Upsetting as it is, the same cannot be said about the human visitors… 😡

This is the reason why the Peru government hired the best experts in the world to save this place! 👍 You’ve also been tasked with an experimental archeology and restoration of a few houses. Hopefully you’ll uncover some tracks left behind and the aliens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/ec9471d49799ac2b214f431080526fec449c3101.jpg
The next map to be introduced when Monument Flipper 🔨 leaves the EA is the legendary Machu Picchu. Let us know in the comments what other Monuments would you like to see in the full version of the game! Don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist 👇 and join our discord community 👇 where you can meet other people interested in our production!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/6134245980c5bf6a953a434d0385fe4d97ea4a73.jpg
The Temple’s building had begun around the year 1400 b.c. by the order of the pharaoh Amenhotep III and continued for almost 200 years before it was finished during the reign of the Ramses II. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/c2a7d1dc4b236ad647b5354f69f12de4162fd714.jpg
Currently, the entire temple is converted into a museum. 📝They even got a big mummy museum with lots of exhibits. There is no way we’ll accompany you if you plan to work nights… 😐 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/c4a99423996b1fe77cd0a1cfb2fc0699ed349c26.jpg
And that’s your new task- renovate the 100 pillars in the Luxor Temple and save their beauty from the relentless flow of time. 👷 It’s a tailor-made task for someone with your accomplishments and experience! Therefore, we’re flying to Africa. 🧰

And by the time we arrive… You might want to find out what scares off the mummies and curses because we still need you to save more monuments. 😅

notes.title: New Structure!!
notes.content:
Hello Flippers! 👷

Today, let us take you to the long forgotten past and tell you the history of the next object on your work list. 

III Century BC. Quilian Shan Mountain range, Sino-Mongolian boarder. 🌏 The First Emperor of China Quin Shi Huang 👑 orders the building of a structure which will protect his empire and people from fierce attacks from the North. A structure so monumental, so big that can be seen from space. 🛰️ His descendants continued his work and completed the largest structure to ever exist, ✔️one of the wonders of the world. Chinese people called it many names: “The Earth Dragon”, “10 000 Li’s Wall” but we all know it as the Great Wall of China. Spreading across almost 21 200 km. 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/36fe84d98c93dc2854f0f72575d096dbabb5ecb7.jpg

For many centuries the Wall was left unattended, slowly but surely eroding due to poor quality materials it was built of, as well as many atmospheric factors and changes in climate. 

New government of China decided to put an end to this neglect and here is where YOU come in handy. Who’s more qualified to complete this task but the one who repaired the Notre Dame de Paris and many other legacy buildings? 👷

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/450c642c86c71bb5d3a36d3fb51d4fe8449dbbaa.jpg

The task is simple, yet demanding- repair the collapsed fragments of wall 🧱as well as the guard tower, clean the walls of the debris 🧹, find the artifacts of the past and display them in the rebuilt tower. When you are done, light the bonfires 🔥 and fire the cannons 💥 to find out how the warning system worked on this historical structure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/ab7e7c5f57f0f48a29e99f20460ccbd5a182a3b0.jpg

Beware though, you must hurry 🏃because there is an invitation to Luxor pending as well as a business card given to you by the conservator of Machu Picchu. 🤩

Long story short, we present to you the NEW STRUCTURE: Great Wall of China!! 🤩. Because of it’s tremendous size, we are still working on it but worry not, waiting a bit longer will be worth it. 😍

We really appreciate your suggestions and comments about the game and it’s contents so join our discord community 👇 and let us know which structures would you love to see in the game.

notes.title: DATE REVEAL 🏛️ | Early Access
notes.content:
Dear Players 👷👷‍♀️

We are really happy to announce that Monuments Flipper will be available in Early Acces on: 

November 14th, from 5 pm CET/8 am PDT! 🥳

[previewyoutube=3yPmx4EpLnE;full][/previewyoutube]

We are extremely proud that Monuments Flipper will be available for purchase at Early Access in just 9️⃣ days. On this occasion, we have prepared for you several available monuments that will require renovation, there will be plenty of work to do. 🏛️

Additionally, despite the fact that the game will be available on EA, we decided to translate the game into the following languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, and Traditional Chinese.

Due to the fact that the game will be available for purchase in Early Acces, players who will want to support our work can count on a very good price on the EA premiere and extra launch discount, which we promise from the very beginning of Monuments Flipper production. 🏰

Some of you may be surprised why the game will be released in Early Access, we are in a hurry with all the explanations:

Why Early Access?We decided that Monuments Flipper will be available in Early Access because the game now has a lot to offer, and we have a lot of work ahead of us. The game already has ready-made famous monuments from France, which allows you to spend several hours in the game.

We are still working on many locations from different parts of the world and we are counting on the feedback that players will provide us during the Early Access, including what monuments they would like to see in the full version of the game.

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?The game will remain in early access until all features are complete and the game is stable and fun to play. Anticipated full release is Q2/Q3 2023.

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?The locations are the biggest difference between the Early Access version and the full version of the game. Early Access includes all locations in France, while the full version of the game will include locations around the world. In addition, thanks to the feedback provided by our players, we will be able to improve all the mechanics and features in the game.

What is the current state of the Early Access version?Currently, in the Early Access version, all locations in France are available: Eiffel Tower,
 Notre Dame Cathedral,
 Azay-le-Rideau Castle,
 Pont du Gard aqueduct,
 Chapel of Notre Dame de la Garde,
 Saint-Michel d'Aiguilhe Chapel,
 Moulin de Jerusalem,
 Old Village, 
 Old Tavern.
Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?Early Access will be given a discount (+launch discount) as a thank you for playing and for providing feedback to help shape the direction of Monuments Flipper's development.

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?The community is the main reason for creating this game and putting it into Early Access. For over a year of game production, an amazing community has been created, which for many months has been providing us with valuable feedback and information, about what they are expected from us in the full version of the game.

Our amazing community already exists on Steam Community Hub and on a dedicated Discord server, where we exchange all thoughts, ideas, and information. The most important is that we can create Monuments Flipper together!

We strive to collect all important information from our community on an ongoing basis to improve our game and meet our community's expectations. This way, everyone can be part of the game.

Do you have any questions? Write to us on Discord 👇

Thank you for being with us for over a year, taking part in the premiere of the demo version and the prologue, and now you can be part of the upcoming premiere, see you on November 14, 2022, at 5:00 PM.

Regards,
Monuments Flipper Team.

Today we would like to introduce another essential feature of our game. Last time, we were learning how to deal with the unwanted and destroyed environment. But what if we find something that may be used later? In this case, let's talk a bit about restoring elements. 

When we find something that looks really promising, but we think that it needs a bit of polishing, here comes our special table. 😀 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/b26051d442f347349d9113b6eb0169976c783a53.png

After interacting with it, we can notice some very cool options such as "combine" and "renovation". Let's focus on the second one. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/3793c6bad81b577c1486d101dfcbaed710d5a104.png

Now we need to remember to select what we want to renovate - in this case, tiles. We just need to click on them so they will appear on your main screen. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/b5f6468f31b2f27ff8490f993334db43a1bb4100.png

Now it's time to open our inventory and decide what tool we would like to use (cloth). 😀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/f2948cab46966232c95d0aa26f07d4e5a0194133.png

Finally, by holding Left Mouse Button and moving the cursor over dirty areas, we can clean the tiles so we can use them later. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36984907/cd11de13bf296a3babb843ffffc44e9eae438d7f.png

This is all for today. Are you ready for more? Stay tuned for more devlogs! And if you haven't played our demo yet, it's time to do it - PLAY NOW

But before that, if you haven't played our DEMO yet, do it now! 

In Monument's Flipper in many cases you will need to break through some obstacles first, in order to start the real fun. But how to do it?

Now it's time for an axe 🪓
